facts: The phrase "raining cats and dogs" originated in seventeenth-century England. During heavy rainstorms, many homeless animals would drown and float down the streets, giving the appearance that it had actually rained cats and dogs.
A Russian dog named Laika was the first animal in space, traveling around Earth in 1957.
A group of puppies is called a litter.
A dog's sense of smell is so strong that they can detect cancer in humans.
A dog's nose is wet because it helps to cool their body.
